queries.sql: SELECT c.revision_chunk_id,c.content_id FROM revision_chunks c WHERE c.visible_from_generation<=?1 AND (c.visible_to_generation IS NULL OR c.visible_to_generation>?1) AND c.content_id NOT IN(SELECT json_extract(i.input_json,'$.content_id') FROM job_items i WHERE i.item_type='improve-extraction' AND json_valid(i.input_json) AND json_extract(i.input_json,'$.content_id') IS NOT NULL AND json_extract(i.input_json,'$.policy_version')=?2 AND json_extract(i.input_json,'$.prompt_version')=?3) ORDER BY c.revision_chunk_id

SELECT c.concept_id,c.canonical_label,(SELECT count(*) FROM claims q WHERE (q.source_concept_id=c.concept_id OR q.target_concept_id=c.concept_id) AND q.visible_from_generation<=?1 AND (q.visible_to_generation IS NULL OR q.visible_to_generation>?1)) AS degree FROM concepts c WHERE c.visible_from_generation<=?1 AND (c.visible_to_generation IS NULL OR c.visible_to_generation>?1) AND c.lifecycle_state IN('active','migration-parent') ORDER BY degree,c.concept_id
query_plan: SEARCH q USING INDEX claims_source_visibility (source_concept_id=? AND visible_from_generation<?)
SEARCH q USING INDEX claims_target_visibility (target_concept_id=? AND visible_from_generation<?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

queries.sql: SELECT n.note_id,n.note_kind,n.importance,n.uncertainty,n.next_action FROM analysis_notes n WHERE n.state='active' ORDER BY n.importance DESC,n.note_id
query_plan: USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY

queries.sql: SELECT gap_id,occurrence_count,gap_text FROM query_gaps WHERE state='open' ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC,gap_id
query_plan: USE TEMP B-TREE FOR LAST TERM OF ORDER BY

queries.sql: SELECT rc.revision_chunk_id FROM revision_chunks rc WHERE rc.visible_from_generation<=?1 AND (rc.visible_to_generation IS NULL OR rc.visible_to_generation>?1) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM revision_chunk_embeddings rce JOIN embeddings e ON e.embedding_id=rce.embedding_id WHERE rce.revision_chunk_id=rc.revision_chunk_id AND e.embedding_profile_id=?2 AND rce.visible_from_generation<=?1 AND (rce.visible_to_generation IS NULL OR rce.visible_to_generation>?1)) ORDER BY rc.revision_chunk_id
